verdict.rationale: Docs show HumanLayer sessions can use different backends/models — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Claude via Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API — indicating some flexibility in model/provider choice, which implies bringing your own credentials for these paths. However, there is no explicit doc describing a generic 'bring your own API key' mechanism for arbitrary LLMs or a pricing-tier note tying this to cost savings for engineering leads. Missing for 10: explicit BYO-API-key configuration docs, support for arbitrary/third-party model providers beyond Claude/Codex/Bedrock, and any pricing-related messaging about cost control via own keys.
